[P1] Vajiralongkorn Dam
Vajiralongkorn Dam , formerly named the Khao Laem Dam , is a concrete-face rock-fill dam ( CFRD ) in Thong Pha Phum district in Kanchanaburi , Thailand . The dam lies across the Khwae Noi River ( River Kwai ) and was renamed Vajiralongkorn Dam after Crown Prince Maha Vajiralongkorn on July 13 , 2001 . Vajiralongkorn Dam is Thailand 's first CFRD and supplies a 300 MW hydroelectric power station with water .

[P2] Vajiralongkorn
Maha Vajiralongkorn Bodindradebayavarangkun ( มหาวชิราลงกรณ บดินทรเทพยวรางกูร , , [ mā.hǎː.wá.t͡ɕʰí.rāː.lōŋ.kɔ̄ːn bɔ̄ː.dīn.tʰrá.tʰêːp.pʰā.já.wá.rāːŋ.kūːn ] ; born 28 July 1952 ) is the King of Thailand , since 2016 . He is the only son of King Bhumibol Adulyadej and Queen Sirikit . In 1972 , at the age of 20 , he was made crown prince by his father . After his father 's death on 13 October 2016 , he was expected to succeed to the throne of Thailand but asked for time to mourn before taking the throne . He accepted the throne on the night of 1 December 2016 but will not be crowned formally until after the cremation of his father . The government retroactively declared his reign to have begun on 13 October 2016 , upon his father 's death . As the tenth monarch of the Chakri Dynasty , he is also styled as Rama X . At the age of 64 , Vajiralongkorn is the oldest Thai monarch to ascend to the throne .

[P5] Suthida Vajiralongkorn na Ayudhya
General Suthida Vajiralongkorn na Ayudhya , née Suthida Tidjai ( สุทิดา ติดใจ ; born 3 June 1976 ) is a Thai military officer , currently Commander of the Special Operations Unit of the King 's Guard , holding the rank of full General . Formerly a flight attendant with Thai Airways , she was appointed commander of Crown Prince Vajiralongkorn 's household guard in August 2014 . Several reports , following the Crown Prince 's divorce of Srirasmi Suwadee , have linked her romantically to the Crown Prince , that she lives in Munich . In October 2016 , international media reports label her as the designated king 's `` consort '' , despite the Palace never officially declaring their relationship . Her name is consistent with naming customs for the wives of Thai princes .
